Paired Beacon-first and Yosys leaf measurements and the named cheaper-correct-alternative experiment are complete and independently reviewed.
No interface, ISA, installed API layout, configuration defaults, toolchain pins, golden values, tolerance or existing test-coverage change creates a further contract-specific obligation.
Local immutable governance and both hosted governance runs pass; dedicated integration workflows pass.
Pending generic regression/parity/performance/logic cases remain useful broader coverage, but no unfulfilled repair-specific test was identified that only those cells supply.
limits: The pending broader matrix is not a pass and may still expose a real defect; root must inspect new failures.
Leaf response timing and static absence of timing-model changes do not constitute full workload parity, AFU execution or physical timing proof.
No blanket permission to ignore unrelated future failures or required checks is implied.
